summary: Reviewed git diff master...HEAD line by line: production API behaviour is unchanged (NODE_ENV=production still baked into apps/api/Dockerfile's runtime stage, resolveListenHost keeps the runtime default there), server.ts still statically imports only ./env.js and ./db/local-database-guard.js with resolveListenHost pulled in dynamically in the correct position, listen-host.ts is pure with no process.env reads, the make help awk works correctly under this machine's real BSD awk (20200816), and make dev remains the interactive selector. Both named oracles (node --test scripts/__tests__/dev-localhost-only.test.mjs and apps/api's vitest listen-host.test.ts) pass and were proven non-vacuous via two independent mutations (vite host:true, Makefile DEFAULT_GOAL:=dev), each producing a clean RED then restored cleanly with git checkout. All four full gates - lint, type-check, test, build - are green with exit 0. The pre-existing dev-identity-docs-reconciliation.test.mjs missing-file quirk is confirmed present and unrelated to this slice. Integration tests (pnpm --filter @fxl-sales/api test:integration) failed 5 files/1 test because this worktree has no .env and thus no fxl_sales_test role configured, falling back to the postgres superuser against the local Docker DB - a documented environment limitation, not a slice defect, since it is orthogonal to everything this diff touches. Security checks passed: no secrets added, nothing binds 0.0.0.0 by default in dev, and SALES_LISTEN_HOST (never bare HOST) is the sole override. No processes were left running by this verification session.
